achievements.title: Brothers in Arms
achievements.description: Finish the story with Lance as a true partner.

achievements.title: The Reasonable Adult
achievements.description: Pay off the debt and leave.

achievements.title: Empire Collapse
achievements.description: Create a destructive empire without lasting stability.

achievements.title: Forelli Victory
achievements.description: Lose the power struggle to Sonny.

opening_deal.title: The Deal
text: The exchange was supposed to be simple. Money. Cocaine. A clean handoff in the neon haze of Vice City.
Instead, the warehouse erupts in gunfire. The cash is gone. The product is gone. And Tommy Vercetti is left staring at a dead courier and a phone that is already ringing.
Sonny Forelli wants answers. The city is watching. And Tommy realizes the bad deal may be only the beginning.

choices.label: Call Sonny and tell him the truth
Lie and buy yourself time
Tell Sonny he is not getting another dollar

sonny_call.title: The Phone Call
text: Sonny listens, then laughs once before the line goes cold. He is furious, but he has seen Tommy survive worse than this.
The boss gives him one task: find the men responsible, and make the loss right.
In Vice City, a favor from Sonny can be a weapon. A refusal can be a death sentence.

choices.label: Start an investigation and trace the missing shipment
Use the network and look for a fixer

sonny_lie.title: The Lie
text: The lie is smooth, fast, and ugly. Sonny is not convinced, but he is unwilling to waste a man he has not yet decided to kill.
Tommy leaves the call with a new problem: the city knows he is vulnerable, and everyone wants a piece of his panic.

choices.label: Look for Diaz and work the city quietly
Ask Lance to help stabilize the operation

cut_ties_scene.title: Cut Ties
text: The words hit like a gunshot. Sonny goes silent. Tommy can almost hear the gears in the Forelli machine turn toward him.
He is not just in debt. He is in open rebellion. The city starts to make sense: everybody has a side and a price.
This is the moment where the empire begins to become more than a simple delivery route.

choices.label: Move out on your own and build influence
Find work with Diaz and learn the game from the inside

investigation.title: The Investigation
text: A trail leads to a set of interviews, broken ties, and a few very expensive mistakes. Looters, smugglers, and ambitious hustlers all smell blood in the water.
Lance keeps asking when the city will start paying him back. Diaz keeps smiling like he already knows which side is going to win.

choices.label: Trust Lance and build an alliance
Approach Diaz with a proposal
Take the money and keep your head low

lance_support.title: Lance in the Middle
text: Lance is angry, eager, and deeply impressed by Tommy for once. It is not trust exactly. It is more like a spark in a dry room.
Tommy can steer it toward partnership, control, or disaster. The dozen little choices in between are where empires are born.

choices.label: Treat Lance as an equal partner
Use Lance as muscle and keep him at arm's length

diaz_meeting.title: The Diaz Meeting
text: Diaz is calm in a way that feels expensive. He talks like a man who has already mapped the city in his head and is just waiting to see whether Tommy is useful or disposable.
The deal is lucrative. The cost is subtle. One promise made in private can become a chain on a future Monday morning.

choices.label: Take Diaz's offer and work the city together
Play both sides and keep your options open
Set Diaz up and prepare for a hostile takeover

lance_alliance.title: The Risk of Trust
text: The city asks for one thing: loyalty. Lance needs to believe Tommy will not discard him. Tommy needs Lance to see him as a partner, not a superior with a gun.
A shared plan could make them unstoppable. A badly handled ego could turn a brother into a rival.

choices.label: Treat Lance like a true partner and share the empire
Put Lance in charge of operations and keep control yourself
Keep Lance close but make sure he never gets too comfortable

money_route.title: The Quiet Route
text: A pile of money buys a little breathing room. The city keeps moving regardless. Sonny is still angry. Diaz is still watching. And Tommy realizes that eventually every quiet move becomes a visible one.

choices.label: Cash out and leave Vice City before it devours him
Double down and build a bigger empire anyway

diaz_betrayal.title: The Break
text: Diaz reacts like a man who has spent a lifetime planning for a knife in the back. Tommy is no longer a pawn. He is a problem.
The next move determines whether the city belongs to a king, a partner, or a corpse.

choices.label: Take Diaz out and claim the city for yourself
Use Lance against Diaz and split the spoils later

diaz_partnership.title: The Partnership
text: Diaz keeps his promises. Tommy keeps his nerve. It is a working arrangement, not a love story. Yet somewhere in the city, the quiet kind of power is the most dangerous kind of all.

choices.label: Stay aligned with Diaz and let the empire grow around the arrangement
Play nice for now, but start preparing to betray him

final_push.title: Final Push
text: The final confrontation begins with fireworks, blood, and bad decisions. Sonny is circling. Diaz is alive or dead depending on the path. Lance is a partner, a rival, or a ghost.
Tommy has enough influence to either become the king of the city or the bloodstain beneath it.

choices.label: Strike hard and take the city outright
Keep Lance close and split the empire
Let Lance decide the terms and prepare for betrayal
Try to outmaneuver Sonny but fail to secure enough power
Push too far and turn the empire into a war zone
Take the money, leave the city, and call it a win

ending_king_of_vice_city.title: King of Vice City
text: Tommy takes the city by force, outlasting the worst of Sonny and the chaos of Diaz. He wins by being harder, faster, and less sentimental than everyone else.
Vice City becomes his. The neon never stops flashing. The city never sleeps. And the men who were meant to break him are now room-temperature memories.

ending.title: King of Vice City
ending.summary: Tommy defeats Sonny and claims the city as his own.

ending_vercetti_vance.title: Vercetti & Vance
text: Tommy and Lance realize the only way to survive the city is to stop pretending the other is disposable. They share the empire, the risk, and the blood.

ending.title: Vercetti & Vance
ending.summary: Lance remains a partner instead of a rival.

ending_lance_vance.title: Lance Vance
text: Lance sees the hand on the trigger, step aside, and choose his own future. He betrays Tommy, takes the empire, and smiles through the blood.

ending.title: Lance Vance
ending.summary: Tommy is outmaneuvered and Lance takes control.

ending_forelli_victory.title: Forelli Victory
text: Tommy loses the war before he ever truly wins it. Sonny outlasts him, and the city turns its back when it is time to collect the debt.

ending.title: Forelli Victory
ending.summary: Sonny wins the blood feud and the city remains loyal to the old order.

ending_diaz_empire.title: Diaz Empire
text: Tommy keeps his promises to Diaz and becomes another voice in the machine. The arrangement works. The empire grows. But Tommy never stopped becoming someone else.

ending.title: Diaz Empire
ending.summary: Tommy remains aligned with Diaz and builds an uneasy empire beneath him.

ending_empire_collapse.title: Empire Collapse
text: Tommy wins the battle but not the peace. The empire is too violent, too volatile, and too broken by the people he trusted to stand still for long.

ending.title: Empire Collapse
ending.summary: Power is won quickly and lost just as quickly.

ending_reasonable_adult.title: The Reasonable Adult
text: Tommy takes the money, quits the game, and leaves Vice City with his skin intact. It is the most boring ending in town, and somehow it may be the smartest one.

ending.title: The Reasonable Adult
ending.summary: Tommy pays off the trouble and leaves with enough cash to start over elsewhere.
